title: Evidence
description: An observation the kernel can re-execute. `locator` is what makes evidence a claim the system can check rather than a claim it must believe.

ref.description: Human-readable pointer. For human reading only; never the basis of a check.

reproducible.description: False for a genuinely unrepeatable observation, which caps the assertion it supports at INFERENCE.

predicate.description: Mandatory for kind `log` and `metric`: the kernel re-evaluates a predicate rather than comparing a volatile raw value.

verification.description: Kernel-owned. An envelope arriving with this populated is a contract violation.

predicate.description: A machine-evaluable statement about an observation, e.g. `count == 0` or `error_rate < 0.01`.
